parsed.reason: The reply says plainly that it cannot sign her up and never claims it did or will. Its offer to watch the class page if the class is full is an allowed alternative, because the parent sending the link is what makes the later text theirs. It makes no promise to text once sign-up becomes possible. It loses a point for two reasons: the phrase 'past me' is slightly idiomatic, and it misses the more fitting help for a parent who keeps forgetting, a calendar reminder draft for them to approve.
